project.name: Primary-Backup Replication · net/rpc
project.description: node-1 is the fixed primary and every other node is a backup; writes sent to any node are forwarded to the primary, which assigns increasing log indexes. Supports async/sync replication and local/primary/session reads. There is no automatic failover or log repair, so a crashed primary stays unavailable.
